conclusion: No rejection reproduced; consistent video-service startup reduction. No new event reason or evidence resolving startup causality.
qualification_status: Historical cold-2 strict failure retained; no waiver. Instrumented matched comparison is separate from release qualification.
limitations: Three cold boots/fifteen minutes per arm do not establish absence of a rare rejection.
Some host hotspot reconnections delayed live polling; early outcome coverage uses boot-wide kernel journal and cumulative counters, with no stream restart. Reconnection load varies.
Video-service activation is a software milestone, not a directly measured first visible pixel.
Trace logging may perturb later timing; no physical rejection event occurred to exercise live message decoding.
No matched warm-boot diagnostic comparison is included; earlier five warm qualification boots used the uninstrumented optimized RC.
